EC3: - Patients undergoing diagnostic colonoscopy (e.g. as an evaluation for active gastrointestinal bleed, referring collectively to the stomach [OR] and the small [OR] and large intestine).
EC4: - Patients with incomplete colonoscopies (those where endoscopists did [NOT] not successfully intubate the cecum due to technical difficulties [OR] or poor bowel preparation)
EC5: - Patients that have standard contraindications to colonoscopy in general (e.g. documented acute diverticulitis, [OR] fulminant colitis and known or suspected perforation).
EC7: - Patients with any polypoid/ [OR] ulcerated lesion > 2 cm concerning for invasive cancer on endoscopy
EC8: - Patients referred for endoscopic mucosal resection (EMR), which is a procedure to remove early-stage cancer and precancerous growths from the lining of the digestive tract.
